items.title: OKXICE moves ahead with tokenized stocks as blue chips push back
items.summary: The Nov. 23 debut puts a new SEC exemption to the test as Nasdaq pursues its own tokenized stock plans after warning that trading across platforms could fragment liquidity.

items.title: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound
items.summary: Bitcoin traded in a narrow range as investors bought the dip in tech stocks and US bond yields climbed on high CPI inflation data.

items.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
items.summary: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.
